annotations.title: Explain This Price — why we price a player’s strikes there

description: Why the PredictionMarketsPicks model prices an NFL player's Kalshi prop strikes where it does this week: the projection, The Ladder's verdict (SHAPE, LOCATION, PRICED or market-only), the widest published model-vs-market gap, and what the model does NOT account for. Our number appears only where it is measured calibrated (30–70%). Free, no key. Use for "why do you price <player> there", "explain <player>'s prop", "what's driving the model on <player>", "why is <player>'s over priced at that".

player.description: Player name, full or partial (e.g. "Puka Nacua").

stat.description: Optional stat to narrow to, e.g. "rec_yds", "receptions", "rush_yds".
